description: WPVibe connects ChatGPT to self-hosted WordPress sites so users can manage content, inspect plugins and themes, upload media, run safe WordPress admin commands, use plugin abilities, and build draft themes through conversation. It includes tested WordPress skills and playbooks for Gutenberg, Elementor, SeedProd, classic themes, editable fields, design, and SEO audits, plus one-click authorization, permission-checked tools, and draft-preview-publish workflows so changes are visible and reviewable before risky actions.
